Class OptionalLong

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.jdk.util.OptionalLong
public final class OptionalLong extends Object
The board-side java.util.OptionalLong: the compiler reads this class as java.util.OptionalLong. It covers empty, of, isPresent, isEmpty, getAsLong, orElse and orElseThrow.
